description: Renders one track into a finished master. Each run draws one credit if the account holds a balance; without one it falls back to the free allowance (1 free master per day (UTC), no advanced modules). The job id comes back at once; follow progress with get_job. A run usually finishes in 20-60 s and can take up to 10 min when restoration is on. This server downloads the source itself, so 100 MB per file is the upper bound. Set dry_run=true to see the planned charge and the effective settings with nothing spent.

audio_url.description: Track address as a public https link: a direct file (wav, mp3, flac, m4a) or a sharing link, which the server opens for you.

bitrate.description: Kbps setting. MP3: 128, 192, 256 or 320. OPUS: 128 or 192.

denoise_strength.description: Noise reduction on a 0 to 1 scale; 0 turns it off.

dither_type.description: Applied only when the output is 16-bit WAV. Options: tpdf, the default, plus two noise-shaping variants, ns_e and ns_itu.

dry_run.description: Planning only: reports the expected charge and effective settings. No credit is spent and the file is not downloaded.

intensity.description: Strength factor for the preset's multiband stage. The designed value is 1.0; below it gives a softer result, above it a denser one. Out-of-range input is clamped into 0.5 to 1.5.

out_format.description: Container and encoding of the rendered file.

remove_watermark.description: Runs AI artifact cleanup before mastering as well.

restore_dynamics.description: Expands a crushed source before mastering; intended for the unlimiter style.

style.description: Preset identifier, such as edm, hiphop, podcast or unlimiter (the full set is in list_presets). Falls back to standard.

target_lufs.description: Replaces the preset's loudness goal, e.g. -14 for a Spotify-style target.

webhook_url.description: HTTPS endpoint that receives the finished result by POST, as an alternative to polling.
